decision: Keep every current public URL and the current look. Drop site search. Leave article files where they are.
why: This PR only removes Starlight. The redesign and the move to /blog/ are later PRs.

decision: Copy Starlight 0.42.6 CSS into app/src/styles/vendor and keep its class names.
why: custom.css already targets those classes. Rewriting it would be the next design PR.
The URL list, the file locations, and the look were already fixed by the request.

decision: Keep the docs collection id and the MDX files under app/src/content/docs.
why: llms.txt and the RSS feeds read those ids. Moving files would rewrite import paths inside articles.

decision: Recorded 113 public URLs from the Starlight build.
why: The later build has to match this list.

decision: The plain Astro build drops only the 50 pagefind URLs.
why: Search left with Starlight. Every other URL has to stay.
evidence: npm run build output missing 0 added 0

decision: Create a new heading slugger for each file.
why: One shared slugger turned the only まとめ heading into まとめ-2.
The lib/ rule hid the URL and nav modules, so a commit would not have contained them.
A build without it still emits Mermaid style text. mdx optimize is off, which is what used to corrupt those tags.
evidence: build mermaid style True and set:html False

decision: Allow generated /og/*.webp files in the route check.
why: CI converts OG images to webp before the build, so those files are new URLs the local baseline does not list. App CI failed with added 18.

decision: Emit hreflang en, ja, and x-default from the page head.
why: Starlight wrote those links. The glob loader ids the Japanese home as ja, so the language pair used ja/index and the links never rendered.
